from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,re
root=Path('C:/projects/NEPL3-runtime')
def module(path,name):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
audit=module('tools/audit/structure.py','structure')
forms=json.loads((root/'design/forms.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['categories']
tree=audit.Parser((root/'languages/doc/syntax.neplg').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),forms).complete('Grammar/Root')
actual=audit.signatures(tree,'Doc')
expected={(category,head):v for category,d in forms.items() if category.startswith('Doc/') for head,v in d['forms'].items()}
assert actual==expected
bootstrap=module('tools/bootstrap/grammar.py','seed')
node=bootstrap.source_input((root/'languages/doc/syntax.neplg').read_bytes(),'doc','memory:doc')['root']
declarations=node['fields']['declarations']['list']
guest=[d for d in declarations if d['kind']=='Form' and d['fields']['kind']['value']=='DocGuest']
assert len(guest)==1
read=guest[0]['fields']['fields']['list'][0]['fields']['read']
assert read['kind']=='Foreign',read
assert read['fields']['alias']['value']=='Doc' and read['fields']['category']['value']=='Article'
print('DocGuest actual ReadSpec',read)
helper={'Alignment','ListStyle','Check','OptionalRow','OptionalSentence','OptionalText','LinkTarget','Asset','Row','ListItem'}
assert all('Doc/'+c in forms for c in helper)
signature=(root/'doc/spec/doc-signatures.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
category=None;seen={}
for line in signature.splitlines():
 if line.startswith('## Doc/'):category=line[3:]
 if line.startswith('| `'):
  cols=line.split('|');head=cols[1].strip(' `');kind=cols[2].strip(' `').removeprefix('Doc.');arity=int(cols[-2]);seen[(category,head)]=(kind,arity,cols[3].strip())
def display(read):return 'List<'+display(read['list'])+'>' if isinstance(read,dict) else read
assert seen=={key:(v['kind'],len(v['fields']),', '.join(f['name']+': '+display(f['read']) for f in v['fields']) or '\u306a\u3057') for key,v in expected.items()}
print('Doc forms and actual Grammar source match',len(expected),'forms;',len(helper),'helper categories; signature kind/arity exact')
print('Declaration and signature audit only: does not execute sentence reader or Doc lower')
